title: leucanthemum arcticum subsp. peleiolepis
intro: Leucanthemum arcticum subsp. peleiolepis, commonly known as Arctic Daisy, is a plant species found in the Arctic regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include pain relief, wound healing, and potential anticancer properties, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and scavenge free radicals. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum arcticum subsp. peleiolepis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
